trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions and opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate in us-east, us-west and eu-west. v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I skipped v2.3.1-rc because it only ran in staging and was unhealthy there too. After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0 and healthy, with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** The first request to create the incident timed out. A check showed no incident had been created, so I sent it again with the same duplicate-protection key, which means on-call should only have been paged once. INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and that the service has recovered.

Someone still needs to find what's wrong in v2.3.1 before it's deployed again.
